function.arguments: {"observation": "`arm` and `severity` are strongly associated: clinicians preferentially assigned treatment to sicker patients. The data dictionary confirms: 'Treatment was not randomised. Clinicians preferentially gave the drug to sicker patients, and sicker patients do worse regardless of treatment.'", "implication": "The question asks for the response fraction in the TREATMENT arm only — no comparison is being made to the control arm. Therefore, this confounding by severity does not bias the estimate of the response rate within the treatment arm alone. We are not estimating a treatment effect; we are estimating a marginal response rate in a single group. The association between arm and severity is irrelevant here. This finding does not change the analysis."}
function.name: note_finding
